name: Ghana

latest_census.notes: 2021 Population and Housing Census, 28 June - 11 July 2021, 30,832,019 people, Ghana's first fully digital census. Volume 3C (Background Characteristics) covers nationality, place of birth, marital status, ethnicity, religious affiliation (eight categories incl. Traditional Religion, Other, No Religion). Language: the only language item found is a binary literacy question ('can read and write' across a list of 23 languages); no mother-tongue or language-spoken question surfaced. The questionnaire PDF surfaced (census2021.statsghana.gov.gh/gssmain/fileUpload/pressrelease/2021%20PHC%20Questionnaires.pdf) and can settle this; 'language: false' is my reading of the snippets, not a confirmed absence. nso.url is the host of surfaced GSS URLs, not itself a copied result.

tier_reason: A 2021 census count of religion and ethnicity exists by region (16 = admin1, PDF) and GSS StatsBank advertises the same census at 261 districts (admin2 = 260), but StatsBank is a table-builder whose API I could not verify this session, and the PDF is the only confirmed format. If StatsBank is a PxWeb instance the project's existing pxweb.py reader makes this Tier A.
recommended_action: Open StatsBank first: if it exposes a PxWeb/API endpoint, pull religion and ethnicity by district (261, join to the 260 admin2 shapes by name -- 'Kumasi Metropolitan', 'Ada East' style) and by region (16 = admin1). The admin1 religion/ethnicity currently filled from Afrobarometer Round 9 (a survey) should be superseded by the census; owner review required. Fallback: Volume 3C PDF for the 16 regions. Check the questionnaire PDF to confirm there is no language-spoken question before declaring language not_collected.

summary: Ghana's 2021 census asked religion and ethnicity and publishes both by region in the Volume 3C PDF; the GSS StatsBank platform advertises 2021 census tables with 261-district geo-files, which would match the map's 260 admin2 shapes almost one-to-one. The census would replace the Afrobarometer survey estimates now filling admin1. Language appears to be asked only as literacy in 23 languages, so it is probably a not_collected declaration once the questionnaire is checked. Tier B pending confirmation that StatsBank has an API.
